H01.description: Untrusted decision-row text is emitted into the TSV/JSON/INDEX.md index with < and > (e.g. <script>) and C1 controls not reliably neutralised, letting agent-authored markup reach the rendered index.

H02.description: Any --file target is classed as a fixture, so naming the live ledger or a pending file by path bypasses the CI/hook write refusal and the linked-worktree rule.

H03.description: import accepts --rewrite targets without checking them, so files outside the project, paths with '..', symlinks or missing files are rewritten (or fail mid-import after the ledger is changed).

H04.description: Documentation updated to say interview.pacing is unset by default, following the config example fix.

H05.description: Comment updated to state pacing is unset by default.

H06.description: Comment updated to describe the unset pacing default.

H07.description: The shipped example sets pacing: rounds explicitly, which overrides the mode default so minimal mode gets rounds instead of its documented batch pacing.

H08.description: Adds regression tests for multi-value blocks, escape ids, oversized blocks and large transcripts.

H09.description: Adds tests for --file naming the live/pending ledger under CI and in worktrees.

H11.description: Adds a test that hostile decision-row text is cleaned in all index outputs.

H12.description: Test-helper change: comments and locals of check_operative reworked for the new exemption logic (the helper exempted a whole line if an exempt word appeared anywhere).

H13.description: Test-helper change: check_operative now judges only the clause before the verb match instead of exempting any line containing an exempt word.

H14.description: Adds a fixture test for exempt-word placement.

H15.description: Sets up the temp work directory and limits used by the temp-file rewrite of the round accumulation.

H16.description: Block contents and accumulated rounds are passed to jq as argv strings, so large transcripts or blocks crash on the per-argument size limit; the validation also accepts two JSON values in one block and unvalidated ids.

H17.description: Violation message now prints the malformed reason recorded by the reworked block parsing.

H18.description: Untrusted question ids are printed raw to the terminal, so ESC/control characters in a transcript reach the output.
